purpose: #197: a Verilog-A module that uses the value of an unregistered $systf is refused by name (UnregisteredSystf).

oracle.derivation: Verilog-AMS LRM 12.32 leaves a $name that no standard defines to a VPI application and fixes no value for one nobody registered, so a host with no such application has no value to give and refuses the call by name.

confirmed.result: ngspice exit 1: Error on line 3 or its substitute: / Simulation interrupted due to error!; Xyce exit 1: Netlist error in file d.sp at or near line 4 / Simulation aborted due to error.  There are 0 MSG_FATAL errors and 1 MSG_ERROR
